cargo_details.name: windows-sys
cargo_details.justification: purrassist-host's only Windows-only dependency ([target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies], default-features = false, Win32_Foundation + Win32_Storage_FileSystem only), providing raw kernel32 bindings (SetFileInformationByHandle, MoveFileExW, FlushFileBuffers) for R6 Windows filesystem durability (crates/host/src/files/windows.rs). Header-generated FFI signatures and constants only; no runtime logic beyond linking. Resolved on every platform because Cargo includes target-specific dependencies in the lock file regardless of the host running cargo metadata; compiled only under cfg(windows).
